svg.title: Three visual directions for Asterism
svg.desc: The same example asterism of the Giant tier drawn in three directions: Negative (black stars on pale glass with a red pencil circle), Lightbox (warm light through holes in a dark umber card), and Diffraction (warm white stars with spikes on graphite). Below each, the five tier marks and a six-colour palette.
svg.text: Example geometry only, seed 417, tier Giant. Marks left to right: Dust, Ember, Star, Giant, Nova.
